Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “longest win streak” by applying a strict “wins-only” definition that treated a tie as breaking the streak, concluding the record was 22 (2017 Indians). This contradicted the evidence surfaced (e.g., 1916 New York Giants), for which MLB historically recognizes a 26-game winning streak (ties neither count nor break the streak). This definitional error led to the incorrect final answer and premature task completion.
